prompt: With arm1, move box1 from the shelf to the table, then send channel "ops" how long the whole job took.

paths.when: the box is moved and the elapsed time is sent

world_1_5.note: no clock: `elapsed` needs none (0042 T7), so this is a program

why: 1.8 has no clock reading and no arithmetic, so the time the task took cannot be sent. 1.9 reads `elapsed` after the last step and sends it in seconds (0042 T1, T8). The world has no `clock`: `elapsed` still works (T7).
